task_intent: Compose a multi-source synthesis on responsible-ML tradeoffs (privacy, fairness, explainability), then accept the offer to crystallize it into a committed analysis page.
spine_must_hold: Synthesis draws on multiple real sources; on acceptance the system creates exactly one wiki/analyses page, cites real sources, and commits — no other mutation.

gold_themes.description: Privacy attack types + differential privacy as the lectures frame them.
Fairness / responsible-ML considerations from the systems lectures.

gold_anti_themes.description: Citing the not-yet-created analysis page as an existing source, or fabricating provenance in the committed page.

turns.user_template: Synthesize what the course covers on the tension between privacy, fairness, and explainability in deployed ML. Draw on the primary sources and any existing analysis pages, and cite them.
Good. Which specific lecture sources and wiki pages did this draw on? List them with exact locators.
Yes — please crystallize this into a committed analysis page in the wiki, citing those sources.

notes: Acceptance case: crystallization_accept. Requires mode=crystallization (allow_crystallization). Deterministic check validates exactly one wiki/analyses page created + committed + cites resolve + no other mutation.
